answer: With token supply capped and issuance audited, forging N identities costs N times the market price plus the lost staking yield, making mass impersonation economically irrational while honest participants recover value through verified work. Each agent must burn a unique jade token at a registered vertex to join, and that token's ember receipt decays over epochs, so a sybil farm must acquire and destroy one scarce token per identity. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
